description:

Key Account Pleno/Sênior Options & Company – Salvador, Bahia, Brazil

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um profissional com profunda capacidade de construção e gestão de relacionamentos de alto valor, visão estratégica de longo prazo e histórico comprovado na expansão sustentável de carteiras complexas. O Key Account Pleno / Sênior será o guardião das contas mais relevantes da organização – responsável não apenas por preservar a receita existente, mas por identificar, estruturar e capturar sistematicamente novas oportunidades dentro do ecossistema de cada cliente.

Mais do que um gestor de relacionamento, este profissional atua como parceiro estratégico do cliente: alguém capaz de compreender profundamente os desafios do negócio, antecipar necessidades, propor soluções de alto impacto e influenciar decisões em múltiplos níveis hierárquicos.

    Posicionar‑se como consultor de confiança do cliente, antecipando necessidades, propondo iniciativas antes que sejam demandadas e participando ativamente de discussões sobre estratégia e resultados do negócio do cliente.

    Mapear e gerenciar o ecossistema de influenciadores e decisores de cada conta, desenvolvendo estratégias de engajamento customizadas por persona.

    Atuar como defensor interno do cliente, garantindo que as demandas e expectativas das contas estratégicas sejam priorizadas adequadamente pelas áreas de produto, operações e suporte.

    Ser o principal responsável pelo atingimento das metas de Net Revenue Retention (NRR) e Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) da carteira sob gestão.

    Desenvolver estratégias de renovação antecipada e condução de processos de renegociação complexos, equilibrando flexibilidade comercial com preservação de margem e percepção de valor.

    Elaborar propostas comerciais estratégicas e materiais de apresentação executiva, com narrativa clara orientada ao ROI e ao impacto de negócio do cliente.

    Colaborar estreitamente com os times de Customer Success, Produto e Operações para garantir que a entrega sustente a percepção de valor e reduza o risco de churn.

  • Inteligência de Mercado e Contribuição Estratégica

    Monitorar movimentos competitivos, tendências de mercado e mudanças no ambiente de negócios dos clientes estratégicos, utilizando esse conhecimento para antecipar riscos e oportunidades.

    Contribuir com insights qualificados para o desenvolvimento de novas ofertas, ajustes de posicionamento e evolução de estratégias comerciais, a partir da escuta ativa e do relacionamento próximo com as contas.

    Reportar com consistência e precisão os KPIs de carteira para as lideranças, apresentando análises aprofundadas e recomendações estratégicas fundamentadas.

    Atuar como mentor e referência para profissionais de contas em estágios anteriores de carreira, contribuindo com o desenvolvimento do time e a evolução das práticas de gestão de contas da organização.

Competências Técnicas

  • Domínio avançado de CRM e ferramentas de gestão de carteira, com capacidade para estruturar pipelines de expansão, acompanhar health scores e gerar relatórios executivos com precisão analítica.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados de conta – consumo, receita, engajamento, risco – para transformar informações em estratégias de ação e narrativas de valor junto ao cliente.
  • Proficiência na construção de planos de conta (account plans) estruturados, incluindo mapeamento de stakeholders, análise de whitespace e definição de iniciativas prioritárias de expansão.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e apresentar materiais executivos de alto nível – QBRs, EBRs, propostas de valor e business cases – com rigor metodológico e clareza de comunicação.
  • Experiência com frameworks de gestão de contas estratégicas (SPIN, Challenger, MEDDIC, Miller Heiman ou equivalentes) aplicados ao contexto de expansão e retenção.
  • Fluência em ferramentas de comunicação, videoconferência e colaboração remota para condução eficaz de interações com clientes distribuídos geograficamente.

Perfil e Requisitos

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em gestão de contas estratégicas, Customer Success sênior ou vendas consultivas B2B com carteira de clientes de alto valor.
  • Histórico comprovado de expansão de receita em carteiras complexas, com métricas documentadas de NRR, up‑sell e cross‑sell.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com habilidade de interpretar dados de negócio, construir argumentos estratégicos e sustentar recomendações com evidências.
  • Habilidade de navegação em organizações complexas, com experiência em engajamento multi‑stakeholder e influência sem autoridade formal.
  • Capacidade de liderança e mentoria para contribuir com o desenvolvimento de profissionais de contas em estágios mais iniciais de carreira.
  • Certificações em metodologias de gestão de contas, negociação estratégica ou vendas consultivas (diferencial).
  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Marketing ou áreas correlatas. Pós‑graduação ou MBA é considerado diferencial.
  • Trabalho 100% Presencial.
  • Disponibilidade para viajar uma vez por semana.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão de longo prazo e orientação estratégica – compreende que a gestão de contas é construída em horizontes de tempo, não em transações isoladas.
  • Inteligência relacional – lê dinâmicas interpessoais com acuidade, adapta o estilo de comunicação por interlocutor e constrói confiança com consistência.
  • Mentalidade de dono – assume responsabilidade integral pelos resultados da carteira, sem esperar que o ambiente externo dite o ritmo.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados – transita com naturalidade entre o relacionamento e a análise, usando ambos como instrumentos de criação de valor.
  • Proatividade estruturada – identifica oportunidades antes que se tornem óbvias e age com método, não por impulso.
  • Comunicação executiva – articula ideias complexas com clareza e precisão, tanto no nível operacional quanto no estratégico.
  • Resiliência e estabilidade emocional – mantém qualidade de presença e raciocínio em situações de pressão, renegociação e complexidade.

Benefícios & Experiência na empresa

  • Estrutura e Segurança – Cartão Flash flexível (alimentação / refeição / mobilidade), Plano de Saúde completo, Seguro de Vida, Café da manhã diário no escritório.
  • Alta Performance & Saúde Integral – Programa Alta Performance e Vitalidade com treinamento físico, acompanhamento nutricional e acesso ao TotalPass (academias e bem‑estar).
  • Consultas médicas.
  • Cultura e Ambiente – orientação à alta performance com responsabilidade, proximidade com tomada de decisão, ambiente meritocrático, troca constante com profissionais de alto nível.

The group operates through a decentralized model, bringing together a diverse set of businesses across multiple geographies and industries. Each company retains a high degree of autonomy, while benefiting from shared expertise, strategic guidance, and disciplined capital allocation.

In Brazil, the organization is experiencing a strong growth phase, driven by ongoing acquisitions. This expansion brings both opportunity and complexity, particularly in strengthening leadership capabilities and ensuring consistent performance across independently operated businesses.

Purpose of the Position

As the organization continues to expand through acquisitions, this role has been created to strengthen leadership capability and talent scalability across its businesses. Operating at the intersection of growth and integration, the position focuses on shaping and advancing a talent strategy that supports long-term performance, leadership continuity, and organizational resilience.

Based in Brazil, the role will initially support the local group of businesses, while being designed with a broader, multi-entity mandate and the potential to expand across Latin America over time.

This is a highly strategic position centered on designing and evolving talent architecture across multiple business units, rather than focusing on the execution of established HR programs within a single organization. Working within a decentralized and lean environment, the individual will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing key decisions related to leadership, succession, and organizational effectiveness.

Impact will be driven through influence, coaching, and the ability to leverage existing HR and business resources, rather than through a large, dedicated team. Over time, success will be reflected in stronger leadership pipelines, scalable succession frameworks, and a measurable reduction of leadership risk, particularly in post-acquisition environments.

  • Build and embed scalable talent frameworks across a diverse and growing group of businesses

  • Influence senior stakeholders across decentralized business units
  • Support sustained growth by aligning talent strategy with ongoing expansion

Behavioral Skills

  • Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity

We're hiring a mid‑level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.

Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.

The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM‑powered features. This isn't a research project. We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.

We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.

The Role

We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.

This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.

What You'll Do

  • Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.
  • Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.
  • Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.
  • Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.
  • Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.
  • Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.
  • Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in‑house tooling.
  • Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.
  • Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.
  • Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.
  • Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don’t trust or read the results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.
  • Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi‑step, tool‑using systems.
  • Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research‑adjacent domain.
  • Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non‑engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.

Why This Role

  • You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.
  • AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.
  • Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.
  • Direct access to real‑world, high‑stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.

This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Farmacêutico - Oncologia (Salvador)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Farmacêutico - Oncologia (Salvador) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Atuar como Farmacêutico Clínico e Assistencial no Centro de Infusão, garantindo a qualidade da farmacoterapia e a segurança do paciente oncológico.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Análise Técnica de Prescrição: Validar a dose prescrita cruzando dados laboratoriais e medidas antropométricas;
  • Identificar e gerenciar medicamentos de uso contínuo que o paciente utiliza, evitando interações medicamentosas com o protocolo quimioterápico;
  • Acompanhamento Farmacoterapêutico: Monitorar o paciente durante todo o ciclo do tratamento para avaliar a eficácia e o surgimento de novos problemas relacionados à farmacoterapia;
  • Orientação de Alta: Instruir o paciente e seus cuidadores sobre o uso racional de medicamentos adjuvantes em casa;
  • Gestão de Reações Adversas (RAM): Identificar, registrar e analisar a causalidade de suspeitas de reações adversas durante ou após a infusão;
  • Prevenção de Erros: Implementar barreiras de segurança, como a dupla checagem na dispensação e manipulação de drogas de alta vigilância;
  • Preparação de Antineoplásicos: Manipular quimioterápicos em Cabines de Segurança Biológica;
  • Cálculo de Estabilidade: Determinar o tempo de vida útil do medicamento após a diluição e a compatibilidade com diferentes tipos de soros e materiais (PVC, fotossensibilidade);
  • Análise de RAM: Realizar análise de notificações de suspeita de reação adversa (RAM);
  • Cadastro: Atuar em revisões de cadastros, itens de prescrição e manual farmacoterapêutico, a fim de atualizar indicação, posologia, incompatibilidades medicamentosas e interações medicamentosas;
  • Padronização: Revisar padronização da unidade periodicamente e sugerir itens com melhor custo-benefício, considerando qualidade, efetividade e segurança;
  • Monitorar as atividades dos auxiliares de suprimentos;
  • Supervisar e realizar inventários periódicos;
  • Compreender e acompanhar os indicadores, resultados e melhoria contínua juntamente com a liderança;
  • Participar da Comissão de Farmácia e Terapêutica (CFT).

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Farmácia;
  • CRF ativo;
  • Pós-graduação em Atenção Farmacêutica e Farmácia Clínica em Oncologia;
  • Experiência em Manipulação de Quimioterápicos;
  • Vivência em Farmácia Clínica e Farmacovigilância;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de estoque e ciclo de assistência farmacêutica hospitalar;
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistema MVSOUL e MVPEP.

Informações adicionais

O que você terá por aqui:

Saúde e Bem-Estar

  • Assistência Médica: Cobertura ambulatorial, hospitalar e obstetrícia para você e seus dependentes legais.
  • Assistência Odontológica: Planos com subsídio da empresa que atendem desde procedimentos básicos até ortodontia e próteses.
  • Convênio Farmácia: Facilidade para compra de medicamentos em rede credenciada com desconto em folha e limite baseado no salário.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): Plataforma de bem-estar com acesso a academias e aplicativos de saúde, extensivo a até 3 dependentes.

Alimentação e Refeição

  • Cartão Refeição: Valor creditado por dia útil trabalhado para suas refeições diárias.
  • Cartão Alimentação: Crédito mensal gratuito para auxílio nas compras de mercado.

Proteção e Futuro

  • Previdência Privada: Plano instituído pela empresa para auxílio na formação de reserva financeira e renda futura.
  • Seguro de Vida: Cobertura para morte e invalidez, garantindo proteção financeira para você e sua família.
  • PPR (Programa de Participação de Resultados): Recompensa anual baseada no atingimento das metas coletivas da cooperativa.

Mobilidade e Trajeto

  • Vale Transporte: Disponível para deslocamento entre residência e trabalho em regime presencial ou híbrido.
  • Estacionamento: Convênios com redes de estacionamento próximas às unidades da empresa.

Qualidade de Vida e Parcerias

  • Day Off: Um dia de folga concedido após o seu aniversário para você aproveitar como preferir.
  • Apoio à Família: Auxílio Creche ou Babá para colaboradoras com filhos de até 16 meses.
  • Clube de Vantagens: Parcerias e descontos em instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas e opções de lazer.

Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais : Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam : Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho :

  • Solução de incidentes relacionados aos sistemas de informação, através de alterações na codificação do(s) sistema(s) para correção ou melhoria;
  • Desenvolvimento de funcionalidades (demandas) solicitadas pelas áreas – para isso, é necessário que o analista estude a viabilidade do que foi solicitado, modele soluções que melhor atendam à necessidade do usuário, elabore documentos de especificação (para que o solicitante possa estar ciente do que será feito) e, assim que a(s) funcionalidade(s) estiver (em) pronta (s), garantir seu bom funcionamento;
  • Execução de serviços referentes aos sistemas de informação (por exemplo, consultas à base de dados) solicitada pelas áreas;
  • Orientação e suporte ao usuário, para o caso de dúvidas referentes ao(s) sistema(s) de informação;
  • Execução da atividade em que o analista júnior é o líder técnico. O analista também deve garantir o bom andamento do projeto. Caso seja necessário adquirir mais informações para o entendimento do projeto, o analista deve buscá-las, através de reuniões, documentos, conversas com o solicitante (alinhado com a gestão de demandas), etc.
  • Prezar pela qualidade de entrega e cumprimento de prazos das atividades realizadas, através de testes no código do programa, apoio a homologação, planejamento, etc..

You’ll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long‑term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.

Specifically, your role will involve:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.

  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up‑to‑date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.

The ideal profile

We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:

  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast‑paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem‑solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data‑driven mindset for decision‑making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.

Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

Next steps in the process

  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!

What’s in it for you

  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full‑time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get‑togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.

Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de agentes de transformação que sejam capazes de alcançar realização pessoal e profissional com ética e responsabilidade social.   • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada.   • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

A Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Based in Berlin, Audible is looking for a Campaign Operations Manager (7-month limited contract) who will serve as the planning and operational backbone for large-scale content marketing campaigns of Pottermore productions in the German market. This role will ensure flawless execution across all marketing channels through meticulous coordination, project and process management, and stakeholder communication. They will manage the day-to-day operations of complex 360-degree marketing campaigns, serving as the central coordinator between channel teams, creative teams, agency partners, and external IP stakeholders. Their mission is to ensure all campaign elements are delivered on time, on brief, and on brand through exceptional project management and attention to detail.

They will work closely with Creative, PR, Acquisition, Content Performance, Lifecycle, and Content teams, serving as the operational hub that keeps all workstreams moving efficiently and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate and coordinate various marketing channels including media, lifecycle, acquisition, social media at a global and local level to ensure an integrated marketing approach to the customer.
  • Create and own approval process within Audible and with external partners for all marketing channels managing revision cycles and ensuring brand compliance on both sides.
  • Facilitate discussions, remove roadblocks actively between internal teams and partner brand teams.
  • Manage vetting processes for talent, influencers, experiential elements with external partners, coordinating review cycles and communicating effectively to key stakeholders within Audible.
  • Own all legal and finance operations for large scale content campaigns, actively tracking spends, contracts and coordinating with key stakeholders within Audible and with external partners.
  • Set up and manage regular meetings and information flow with external partners and internal leaders to discuss campaign progress, track approvals, and resolve issues.
  • Own all campaign measurement by being a champion of data and help set up campaign goals based on past experiences; help set up measurement templates and own campaign measurement and reporting.
  • Identify process improvements and implement efficiencies to reduce operational friction in real time. Serve as the go-to problem solver for operational challenges that arise during campaign execution.
  • Own all media coordination and ensure timely fulfilment of assets per pre-agreed plans. Own the media planning to execution cycle across all marketing channels end-to-end.
  • Set up and maintain live project documentation, ensuring all teams have access to current information.

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers' daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

  • Business fluency in English alongside fluent language skills in German.
  • Experience in deep marketing operations or project management.
  • Experience managing multiple complex, multi-workstream campaigns with numerous stakeholders.
  • Experience in managing budgets and contracts.
  • Experience in managing creative production workflows and approval processes.
  • Experience with project management tools and systems like Airtable and Sprinklr.
  • Experience working with external agencies and partner organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in the digital entertainment, media, or content industry.
  • Language skills in French, Italian, Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to coordinate across different teams, C-levels, and external organizations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving blockers.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
  • Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long‑term roadmap for the Windows platform.
  • Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.

An ideal candidate should have

Required

  • 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
  • Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production‑quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi‑threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
  • Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture‑level decisions.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross‑functional teams, and drive consensus.
  • A user‑centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Preferred / Bonus

  • Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
  • Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high‑DPI support, responsiveness under load).
  • Experience with localization/globalization, right‑to‑left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
  • Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long‑term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

  • A high‑impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
  • A collaborative, flat‑structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision‑maker.
  • Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).
  • Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end‑to‑end, and contribute to long‑term product vision.
  • A purpose‑driven mission: building software that’s reliable, accessible, and user‑centered — making a real difference for people.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • O Mecânico de Refrigeração é o profissional responsável por montar, instalar e pôr em funcionamento equipamentos de refrigeração e ar condicionado residencial e comercial, realizando análises, ajustes de performance, detectando e corrigindo falhas de origem elétrica e mecânica, de acordo com desenhos técnicos, projetos e normas técnicas, em condições de qualidade, segurança e preservação ambiental.

  • Efetuar manutenções conforme as recomendações dos fabricantes e check list de atividades de manutenção.
  • Gerenciar e acompanhar os serviços contratados de empresas especializadas em Tratamento de Água, Análise de Qualidade do Ar e Manutenção de Resfriadores de Líquido e Condicionadores de Ar Especiais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ter no mínimo 18 anos de idade;
  • Ter no mínimo o Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Boa comunicação;
  • Necessário ter no mínimo 6 meses de experiência de campo com refrigeração (ar condicionado) - Técnico de refrigeração em ar condicionado;
  • Necessário Formação Técnica em Refrigeração/Climatização.
  • Preferencialmente morar próximo a Unidade Atento Cabula.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Professor De Espanhol em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! A Idioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada. Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

- Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Client Our client is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (AnPaaS) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of client Intelligence and Intelligence Assistant, we're accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts, building deep relationships to maximize value, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, and fuel retention and expansion. You'll collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication of complex concepts and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you'll own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (e.G., NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You'll work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to product growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You're a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor to drive customer success. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You're proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You're collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning and improvement. Requirements 3–5+ years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (SaaS/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record of driving product adoption, value realization, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills;
experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required;
Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment while managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/GenAI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (client values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product and technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side by side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. Join Client! Our client is pioneering the future of embedded analytics with AI at the core. This role offers more than a position — it’s an opportunity to shape customer outcomes in a transformative industry, work with a diverse, innovative global team, and grow in a collaborative culture that values impact and inclusivity. If you're passionate about driving strategic customer success in AI-powered analytics, apply today. Let’s build the next era of intelligent decisions together.

title: Ai Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.G., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops. Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience. QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify\ "Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment. Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions. AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation. Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows. Technical Foundation: Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data). Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering. Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.G., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices. About the Role As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains. This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth. What You’ll Do Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close. Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts. Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions. Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context. Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions. Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals. Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil. What You’ll Bring Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments. Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term. Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains. Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions. Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms. Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller. Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals. Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts. Native or near-native Portuguese fluency. Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly. Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil. Nice to Have Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies. Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries. Working knowledge of Spanish. Why Regrow Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale. High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership. A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise. Competitive compensation and benefits. Acerca de Regrow Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas. Sobre el Rol Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil. Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos. Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR. Qué Harás Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre. Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas. Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast. Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras. Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local. Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas. Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias. Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil. Qué Aportarás Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos. Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo. Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial. Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras. Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS. Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional. Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas. Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento. Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués. Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular. Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil. Deseable Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento. Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales. Conocimiento funcional del español. Por Qué Regrow Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala. Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real. Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica. Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

You understand pacing, retention, hooks, and storytelling from raw unscripted material. Show us your best work Strong short-form editing instinct. You know what makes someone stop scrolling. title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

- Atuação préviacom canais digitais de crédito consignado ou produtos bancários similares;
- Experiência com modelos de clusterização, propensão ou segmentação de clientes.
